properties.name: text
properties.description:
The text configuration for the button.
 Contains the label text to be displayed on the button and any text-specific styling options.

properties.name: icon
properties.description:
Optional icon configuration for the button.
 When provided along with an appropriate [iconMode], displays an icon within the button. Not displayed when [iconMode] is[HexaButtonIconMode.none] or when [variant] is[HexaButtonVariant.destructive].

properties.name: onTap
properties.description:
Callback triggered when the button is tapped.
 Not called when [disabled] or [loading] is true.

properties.name: onLongPress
properties.description:
Callback triggered when the button is long-pressed.
 Not called when [disabled] or [loading] is true.

properties.name: float
properties.description:
Whether the button should have a floating appearance with elevation.
 When true, the button will have a shadow to appear elevated from the surface. Defaults to false. Use it when the button needs to stay visually above inline content.
 Hexa guidance: Use floating elevation when the button must stay visually above inline content.

properties.name: iconMode
properties.description:
The mode determining how icons are displayed within the button.
 Options include leading (icon before text), trailing (icon after text), or none (no icon). Defaults to [HexaButtonIconMode.none].

properties.name: size
properties.description:
The size variant of the button.
 Affects the buttons dimensions, padding, and text size. Defaults to [HexaButtonSize.large].
 Hexa guidance: Use size to balance action prominence with the available layout space.

properties.name: widthMode
properties.description:
The width behavior of the button.
 Options include contained (fixed width based on size), full (expands to fill available width), or flex (wraps content width). Defaults to [HexaButtonWidthMode.contained].

properties.name: variant
properties.description:
The visual variant of the button.
 Affects the buttons colors and appearance. Defaults to [HexaButtonVariant.primary].

properties.name: selected
properties.description:
Whether the button is in a selected state.
 When true, the button displays a selected visual state. Defaults to false. The selected state is intended for primary buttons.

properties.name: loading
properties.description:
Whether the button is in a loading state.
 When true, the button displays a loading spinner and doesnt respond to interactions. Defaults to false. Loading is intended for primary and secondary buttons.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description:
Whether the button is in a disabled state.
 When true, the button has a different appearance and doesnt respond to interactions. Defaults to false.

properties.name: enableFeedback
properties.description:
Whether the button should respond to press animations and gestures.
 When true, the button will animate on press and release. When false, the button will still call [onTap] and [onLongPress] callbacks, but without visual feedback animations. Defaults to true.

object.description:
The Hexa button triggers user actions such as submitting forms, saving data, opening dialogs, or confirming choices.
 Use it as an explicit call to action with a clear label, optional icon, variant-driven emphasis, and immediate visual feedback.
 ## When to use - Trigger an immediate action, such as submit, save, confirm, or start. - Highlight the primary call to action of a screen or section. - Open a dialog, start a process, or confirm a user choice. - Provide an accessible tap target for interactive commands.
 ## When not to use - For inline navigation between pages or sections; use [HexaTextLink]. - For decorative, static, or non-interactive content. - For multiple competing primary actions in the same view.
 ## Anatomy 1. Container: Rounded background that carries the variant and state colors. 2. Button label: Centered text that describes the action. 3. Optional icon: Leading or trailing icon controlled by [iconMode].
 ## Variants - [HexaButtonVariant.primary]: Main call to action for the view. - [HexaButtonVariant.secondary]: Alternative action that supports primary. - [HexaButtonVariant.tertiary]: Low-emphasis action in a related group. - [HexaButtonVariant.destructive]: Critical or irreversible action.
 ## Sizes - [HexaButtonSize.large]: High-visibility actions and main CTAs. - [HexaButtonSize.medium]: General actions in standard layouts. - [HexaButtonSize.small]: Compact spaces or lower-emphasis actions.
 ## States default, hover, pressed, selected (primary only), loading (primary/secondary only), disabled.
 ## Also known as Action Button, CTA, Submit Button, Command Button, Tap Target.
 ## Related [HexaIconButton], [HexaTextButton], [HexaTextLink].
 ## Why this widget - Tree role: The Hexa button triggers user actions such as submitting forms, saving data, opening dialogs, or confirming choices. - Use `HexaButton` when this behavior should be explicit in the screen composition tree.
 [Docs Link](https://www.figma.com/file/bd7yJhBjBbtI2sVhErx9ji/HEXA-Handoff-Mobile?type=design&node-id=2908-13086&mode=design&t=vQA5cdheuQE0rwxl-0)
